INSERT INTO eltm_unprocessed_data (patient_id, external_patient_id, api_code, category, source_key, source_name, suggested_module, reason, raw_value, raw_json, content_hash, status, sync_time) VALUES
(#{item.patientId}, #{item.externalPatientId}, #{item.apiCode}, #{item.category}, #{item.sourceKey}, #{item.sourceName}, #{item.suggestedModule}, #{item.reason}, #{item.rawValue}, #{item.rawJson}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.status}, #{item.syncTime})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE external_patient_id = VALUES(external_patient_id), source_name = VALUES(source_name), suggested_module = VALUES(suggested_module), reason = VALUES(reason), raw_value = VALUES(raw_value), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), status = IF(status IN ('MAPPED', 'IGNORED'), status, VALUES(status)), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time), update_time = NOW()
